question: Fourth edition of Khelo India Youth Games was hosted by which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fourth edition of the **Khelo India Youth Games was actually hosted by the state of Haryana, India.**
 
• The event was held from **January 10 to January 20, 2020**, and took place across various venues in the cities of Panchkula, Ambala, and Chandigarh.
 
• **Over 6,800 athletes from 37 states and union territories participated in 20 different sports disciplines in the games.**
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an annual national-level multi-sport event organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, to identify young talent and promote a sports culture in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Khelo India Youth Games is a national level multi-sport event organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.**
 
• The aim of the games is to identify young talent in various sports disciplines and provide them with a platform to showcase their skills at the national level.
 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games **is held annually and features competitions in multiple sports disciplines, including athletics, boxing, swimming, wrestling, shooting, archery, and gymnastics.
 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games** were launched in** 2018 **and have since then become one of the largest sporting events in the country.
 
• The games are organized in two categories - **Under-17 and Under-21 - **and are held in different parts of the country each year.
 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games **provides a platform for young athletes from all parts of India to compete against each other and showcase their talent at the national level.
